distribuō

distribuō, distribuere, distribuī, distribūtum

verb, third conjugation

distribute; distribute, share out; divide among, distribute

In this lexicon

  • distribute

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Rep. 2.22: reliquum populum distribuit in quīnque classēs (Lewis & Short); Traupman 357

  • divide

    also used · classical · Caes. BG 3.10 (Lewis & Short); Cic. Rep. 2.22: populum in quīnque classēs (Lewis & Short)

  • hand out

    the recommended word · classical · Ter. Ad. 3.3.17: argentum (Lewis & Short); Traupman 33: hand out the papers, distribue (distribuite) chartās; Traupman 325
